query.description: Search text. Accepts nonempty Unicode text of up to 2048 characters. More specific text narrows upstream results.

limit.description: Maximum results. Accepts 1–20, default 10. Higher values may require more upstream pages.

language.description: Language hint. Accepts all or a SearXNG language code such as en or zh-CN. all avoids a language preference.

time_range.description: Upstream date hint. Accepts any, day, month or year. Narrower choices ask the provider for newer results without guaranteeing dates.

domains.description: Allowed result domains. Accepts zero to ten DNS names without schemes. Empty allows all domains, otherwise only each name and its subdomains are returned.

items.description: Domain name. Accepts Unicode or ASCII DNS hostname. IDNA normalization makes equivalent hostnames match.
